title: United Airlines Employee Threatens Customer with ICE Call
summary: A United Airlines passenger was threatened by an employee who allegedly told the customer they did not 'act like a citizen' during a dispute over wait time at San Francisco International Airport. The incident has sparked concerns about racial profiling and the treatment of minority groups. The airline is investigating the matter.
summary_points: A United Airlines passenger was threatened by an employee at San Francisco International Airport
The employee allegedly told the customer they did not 'act like a citizen'
The incident has raised concerns about racial profiling and the treatment of minority groups
United Airlines is investigating the matter
The airline has not commented on whether the employee's actions were racially motivated
